summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing on Langa Scorpions. Backend public GETs, POSTs (incl. consent enforcement + newsletter idempotency), auth login, admin endpoints, CSV export, and events CRUD all passed. Frontend home loads, donate submits (R550 total pledged verified), admin login succeeds with seeded creds, all 9 admin nav sections render, donations table populated.
passed: POST /api/public/newsletter idempotent on duplicate (200 both times)
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin user
GET /api/admin/stats returns 401 without auth, 200 with Bearer
GET /api/admin/export/donations returns text/csv with content-disposition: attachment; filename="donations.csv"
Frontend home loads with Langa/Scorpions/Donate/Volunteer content
Frontend /donate submit succeeds (donation count increments 1->2, total R550)
Frontend admin login succeeds and shows Overview with correct stats
All 9 admin-nav-* testids present (overview, donations, athletes, volunteers, messages, newsletter, events, stories, gallery)
Donations table renders submitted rows after nav
notes: Minor: browser console shows 401 errors on admin page mount before login (expected — /auth/me probe). Not user-facing. Field names for athlete/volunteer POST are date_of_birth+disability and full_name+role_interest respectively (frontend forms already use correct names).
